Subject: Action plan & next steps to start evaluation - Novacare Health

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get Novacare started. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation milestones, owners, and target dates so we can get to a successful pilot by the end of the quarter. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm the evaluation success criteria (page 2 in the MAP).
- Confirm the core stakeholders and a primary technical contact for data access.
- Kickoff meeting to align on roles, timeline, and network/SSO requirements.

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Jun 8, 10:00–10:45 AM PT (we can move if that doesn't work). Rishi (cc'd) will join to walk the integration checklist and ingestion options; Monica (cc'd) will own the customer success plan and ongoing adoption once the contract is active.

Draft attachments: Novacare_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), MAP_Roles_and_Timeline.pdf

What's included in the MAP: evaluation objectives, who owns each milestone, data & security blockers, success metrics (latency, accuracy/regression thresholds), and the expected sign-off gate for a production pilot.

If you want, I can add Priya and your IT security contact to the invite — or you can forward.

Next steps from Marissa: send calendar invite once we lock time; create HubSpot playbook and checklist (linked in the doc).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the MAP — this looks like a good starting point. Priority items from our side:

- Priya Shah (Director of Data) will review evaluation criteria and lead the internal sign-off.
- Carlos (IT Security) needs to run the SOC2 + network access checklist — we need those items answered before data provisioning.
- Procurement needs a formal PO and payment terms; target for internal approvals is Jun 15.

Jun 8, 10:00 AM PT works for our core team — I'll send calendar invites to Priya and Carlos. Please include a short agenda (integration overview, data handoff, success metrics, timeline).

Subject: INTERNAL: Novacare MAP handoff & 30/60/90 checklist (post-kickoff prep)

Monica / Lauren —

Recap and explicit handoff items so nothing falls through the cracks before Tue's kickoff:

Immediate (before kickoff)
- Monica: review MAP_Roles_and_Timeline.pdf and confirm the 30/60/90 success deliverables in a quick comment on the doc (deadline: Mon, Jun 7 EOD).
- Lauren: prepare the evaluation playbook slides (integration steps, sample prompts, latency targets, regression checks) and a short list of what Novacare needs to provision (S3 bucket, service account, IP allowlist).
- Rishi: flag any potential custom connector needs after the kickoff; have a list of questions for Carlos (IT Security).

Post-kickoff (owners & deadlines)
- Day 1–7: Monica to schedule training sessions and collect the customer-runbook requirements (owner: Monica).
- Day 7–21: Lauren to run integration tests and report baseline latency/quality metrics (owner: Lauren).
- Day 21–45: CS to support pilot tuning and adoption checks; prepare a decision review for the pilot sign-off (owner: Monica + Marissa).

Documentation & compliance
- Upload all artifacts to the HubSpot deal and our shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/novacare-eval.
- Ensure Carlos receives our SOC2 summary and network diagram (I'll send separately).

Admin notes
- Deal ID: NW-2027-0610. Target PO approval date (customer): Jun 15.
- Customer stakeholders: Daniel Lee (Clinical Ops), Priya Shah (Director of Data), Carlos Gutierrez (IT Security).
- I'll remain the commercial contact until the PO clears; Monica will be the named CS owner for day-to-day activities.

Please reply with any concerns or if you want me to reassign items. I copied Daniel for visibility but this last note is primarily internal.

Thanks,
